tests: Which service issues temporary credentials to users authenticated by a corporate SAML IdP.
expected: AWS STS via SAML federation — AssumeRoleWithSAML. Triggers: "temporary credentials", "corporate SAML 2.0 identity provider".
why_not: Cognito user pools — for application end users; Identity Center is an option, but STS still issues the credentials; Directory Service — a managed directory, not a credential broker.
